Philosopher Avicenna
The Canon of Medicine is an encyclopedia of medicine in five books compiled by Muslim Persian physician-philosopher Avicenna (ابن سینا, Ibn Sina). The book was completed in 1025 and is one of almost 450 treatises written by Ibn Sīnā. Ibn Sina's fame in Europe rests principally on this work, which was translated into Latin by Gerard of Cremona in the 12th century and remained part of the standard curriculum for medical students until the late 17th century.
